enrichment.headline: Ratifies $81,000 for FM3 Research to survey 1,000 Oakland parents on school enrollment
enrichment.summary: FM3 Research will run an online and phone survey of 1,000 Oakland parents in English, Spanish, Chinese and Arabic. About 750 are parents of current or future OUSD students and 250 have children who do not attend OUSD schools. Findings go to the Student Assignment Department. The board is ratifying an agreement whose April 15, 2026 start date came before this vote.

items.fundingSource: 6762 - Arts, Music, Instructional Material Block Grant

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - FM3 RESEARCH - Student Assignment Department

enrichment.summary: The board adopts Resolution No. 2526-0220, which sets salary schedules for classified confidential administrators and the Executive Cabinet. The item text does not list pay rates or dollar amounts. The resolution comes from the Talent/Human Resources Department.

outcome.action: Adopted

It also covers the public disclosure required under state law (AB 1200 and Government Code Section 3540.2). The item text does not list pay rates or dollar amounts.

enrichment.headline: Approves $5,000 for East Bay Agency for Children to plan the after-school handoff at Hintil Kuu Ca
enrichment.summary: East Bay Agency for Children is the incoming after-school lead agency at Hintil Kuu Ca Preschool. This agreement pays it to take part fully in after-school program planning and to follow all transition steps. The service period is April 1 to June 30, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - East Bay Agency for Children - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Approves $13,480 for Youth Together to pay Skyline High student intern stipends and coordinators
enrichment.summary: Youth Together will process and pay out internship stipends for Pathway students at Skyline High School and fund three student internship coordinators. The details are in Exhibit A of the agreement. The service period is January 1 to June 30, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Youth Together - Skyline High School

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $25,000 for The Center for ArtEsteem to teach drumming and visual arts at West Oakland Middle
enrichment.summary: The Center for ArtEsteem will teach African drumming and visual arts to about 40 students at West Oakland Middle School, one to two days a week. The service period runs from March 30 to July 24, 2026. The board is ratifying an agreement whose start date came before this vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $4,687.50 for a contractor to coordinate the school counselor residency grant
enrichment.summary: Christine Yeh will coordinate the district's School Counselor Residency Grant from the California Commission on Teacher Credentialing. That includes working with the district on mentoring for counselor residents enrolled at the University of San Francisco. The service period is March 15 to June 30, 2026, and the board is ratifying it after the start date.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Christine Yeh - OPSR Counseling Department

enrichment.headline: Approves $423,720 for High-Performance Academy to run after-school sports support at 49 schools
enrichment.summary: High-Performance Academy will deliver about 211,690 hours of direct services to more than 2,940 students at 49 schools over a 36-week year, and aims to reach about 5,000 students through Saturday programs. It will support elementary sports and enrichment programs, run a Saturday basketball and volleyball league, and support NBA Math Hoops at 25 sites. The service period is July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement - High Performance Academy - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Approves $27,600 for Safe Passages to supervise and support recess at Fruitvale Elementary
enrichment.summary: Safe Passages will help supervise the yard during school hours and provide recreation and sports at recess. It will also lead restorative conversations, train conflict mediators, consult with teachers and support students who need extra help. The service period is August 18, 2025 to May 28, 2026, which began before this vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Safe Passages - Fruitvale Elementary School

enrichment.headline: Approves $400,000 for American Youth Soccer Organizations to run sports programs at 49 schools
enrichment.summary: American Youth Soccer Organizations will provide sports and enrichment programming for more than 2,000 students at 49 school sites over a 36-week year, plus Saturday programs reaching about 5,000 students. It will work with the district's Expanded Learning Comprehensive Sports Lead Agency. The service period is July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement - American Youth Soccer Organizations - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Approves applying for a $50,000 Zellerbach Family Foundation grant at Oakland International High
enrichment.summary: The board approves the district's application to the Zellerbach Family Foundation. If awarded, the $50,000 would support student and family engagement, leadership and community-building at Oakland International High School, and help families take an active role in school design. The grant period would run June 1, 2026 to May 31, 2027.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Grant Application - Zellerbach Family Foundation - Oakland International Community and Belonging Project - Oakland International High School

enrichment.summary: 2COACHU will deliver sports and enrichment programming at 49 school sites over a 36-week year, reaching more than 2,000 students during the school week and about 5,000 through Saturday programs. It will work with the district's Expanded Learning Comprehensive Sports Lead Agency. The service period is July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement - 2COACHU - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Approves $84,500 for a consultant to plan training and a digital platform for after-school programs
enrichment.summary: Maria Pelayo Guzman will work with the district's Expanded Learning Office on a needs assessment and a plan for staff training across 84 after-school programs. She will also help design project tracking tools and a website, app and digital toolkit for more than 160 providers serving over 18,000 students daily. She will introduce the platform at the Summer Institute training week. The service period is July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement - Maria Pelayo Guzman - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $6,000 for an individual contractor to lead one-time STEM activities in 10 classrooms
enrichment.summary: Bonita Bumblebee will lead a one-time, one-hour STEM enrichment activity in each of 10 classrooms. The service period is June 8 to July 2, 2026. The board is ratifying an agreement whose start date came before this vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Bonita Bumblebee - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $5,000 for Build California to run an entrepreneurship program at Castlemont High
enrichment.summary: Build California will deliver an entrepreneurship program for 9th graders at Castlemont High School, including the curriculum, teacher training and three events where students present business and nonprofit ideas. It will also run career fairs, events and field trips. The service period is January 15 to June 30, 2026, and the board is ratifying it after the start date.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Build California - Castlemont High School

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $18,750 for Niroga Institute to teach arts in the Summer HAcK credit recovery program
enrichment.summary: Niroga Institute will provide two facilitators to teach a hands-on, standards-based physical arts curriculum for high school students during the Summer HAcK 2026 credit recovery program. The service period is May 15 to June 30, 2026. The board is ratifying an agreement whose start date came before this vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Niroga Institute - OPSR Counseling Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $7,200 for The Mosaic Project to bring social-emotional learning to 4th graders
enrichment.summary: The Mosaic Project will give 4th graders at International Community School social emotional learning and social justice lessons. It will train teachers, provide music for the classroom, present whole-school assemblies and preview the end-of-year field trip. The service period is May 11 to May 15, 2026, and the board is ratifying it after the start date.

items.fundingSource: Title I - Basic Grant Low Income

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: Mumford and Associates, doing business as Village Public Health, will work with the district's Expanded Learning Office to identify 13 professional development topics on youth development practices. The topics are for staff in after-school and summer programs and include activities, discussions and practical tools. The service period is July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027.

enrichment.summary: America SCORES Bay Area will give elementary school sites hands-on help with sports and enrichment programs and run a 9-hour Saturday sports league in the spring. It aims to serve about 2,940 students at 49 schools over 36 weeks, expand Saturday access to about 5,000 students, and deliver about 211,690 hours of direct service. The service period is July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: California School-Age Consortium will deliver 12 to 14 professional development sessions, each 2 hours, for the district's Expanded Learning staff. It plans to reach up to 600 staff participants across 84 after-school programs serving 18,000 youth. The service period is July 1, 2026 to May 31, 2027.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement - California School-Age Consortium - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Approves $110,000 for Attendly to track student sign-in and attendance in the YES! sports program
enrichment.summary: Attendly, Inc. will set up a digital system for registration, real-time sign-in and sign-out, and attendance reporting for the district's YES! sports program. It would support up to 10,000 students at 51 elementary schools, starting with a pilot of Saturday sports and with an option to expand to weekday after-school programs. The service period is July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement - Attendly Inc. - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Approves $20,000 for Be the Change Consulting to train after-school coordinators and directors
enrichment.summary: Be the Change Consulting will work with the Expanded Learning Office to design summer training for after-school site coordinators and agency directors that fits the district's climate and culture goals. It will deliver 12 hours of training on program design, staff supervision, community-building and restorative practices. The service period is July 1, 2026 to May 31, 2027.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: Musson Theatrical will provide and install new stage curtains and the tracks they hang on, and replace the stage performance lights at Montera Middle School.
